summary: The axod terminal-attach command connects a terminal surface to a daemon-owned shell, forwarding user input and terminal dimensions to the PTY while displaying replay and live output from the attachment control stream.
trigger: A terminal client invokes axod terminal-attach with an attachment socket and positive shell ID.

steps.action: Validate the positive shell ID and establish an attachment using protocol v2.
Set stdin to raw mode when it is a terminal and restore the original mode when the guard is dropped.
Copy stdin to the daemon-owned PTY input descriptor and forward initial and SIGWINCH-triggered terminal dimensions.
Read replay-then-live terminal output from the control socket and write it to stdout; stop when the stream closes.
